title: ISP Tracking & DNS Privacy Request Letter Template
metaDescription: Professional template to request ISP data deletion, opt-out of tracking, and protect DNS privacy. Get transparency on your browsing data.
description: A comprehensive letter template to formally request information about your ISP's tracking practices, request data deletion, and establish DNS privacy protections. Includes legal references and actionable privacy steps.

sections.heading: Header Information
sections.content:
[Your Name]
[Your Address]
[City, State ZIP Code]

[Phone Number]

[Date]

[ISP Company Name]
Customer Privacy Department
[ISP Address]
[City, State ZIP Code]

Re: Privacy Rights Request - Account #[ACCOUNT_NUMBER]

sections.heading: Formal Request Opening
sections.content:
Dear Privacy Officer,

I am writing as a customer of [ISP_NAME] to formally request information about my privacy rights and to exercise certain rights regarding my personal data and internet activity monitoring.

This request is made under applicable federal and state privacy laws, including the Communications Act and relevant state consumer protection statutes.

sections.heading: Data Collection Transparency Request
sections.content:
I request detailed information about:

1. What browsing data, DNS queries, and metadata you collect from my internet connection
2. How long this data is retained in your systems
3. Whether my data has been sold, shared, or provided to third parties
4. A complete list of all third parties who have received my data
5. The legal basis for each type of data collection and sharing
6. All privacy policies that have governed my account since [START_DATE]

sections.heading: Opt-Out and Deletion Requests
sections.content:
I formally request to:

• OPT-OUT of all data sales and third-party sharing programs
• DELETE all historical browsing data, DNS logs, and metadata associated with my account
• STOP all non-essential monitoring of my internet activity
• DISABLE any deep packet inspection beyond what's required for basic service delivery
• REMOVE my data from any advertising or analytics programs

Please confirm these changes in writing within 30 days.

sections.heading: DNS Privacy Protection Request
sections.content:
Regarding DNS services:

1. I request that you stop logging my DNS queries beyond technical necessity
2. Please confirm whether you redirect or hijack DNS requests to third-party servers
3. I want to use my own DNS servers ([PREFERRED_DNS]) without interference
4. Provide technical details about any DNS filtering or modification you perform
5. Confirm that you support DNS over HTTPS (DoH) and DNS over TLS (DoT) protocols

sections.heading: Legal Rights and Timeline
sections.content:
Under federal communications privacy laws and state consumer protection statutes, I have the right to:

• Know what personal information is collected and how it's used
• Request deletion of my personal information
• Opt-out of the sale of personal information
• Receive equal service regardless of privacy choices

I request your written response within 30 days of receiving this letter. If you cannot fulfill these requests, please explain the specific legal or technical reasons why.

sections.heading: Contact Information and Follow-up
sections.content:
Please send your written response to:

Email: [YOUR_EMAIL]
Mail: [YOUR_ADDRESS]

If I do not receive a satisfactory response within 30 days, I will consider filing complaints with:
• The Federal Communications Commission (FCC)
• My state's Attorney General office
• Relevant consumer protection agencies

I look forward to your prompt response and to working together to protect my privacy rights.

Sincerely,
[YOUR_SIGNATURE]
[YOUR_PRINTED_NAME]

useCases: Requesting transparency about ISP data collection practices
Opting out of ISP data sales and third-party sharing
Demanding deletion of historical browsing and DNS data
Establishing DNS privacy protections and custom DNS usage

Following up on suspected ISP privacy violations
